name: Sarnadisc MH
tagline: METAL WASHER FOR FIXING OF MEMBRANE TO ROOF STRUCTURES
summary: Rectangular, zinc plated steel washer with rounded edges and specially shaped for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Fastened with one fastener per washer.
metaDescription: Rectangular, zinc plated steel washer with rounded edges and specially shaped for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Fastened with one fastener per washer.
attributes: Resistant to most common environmental influences
Ease of application in use with recommended setting tools
usage: Sarnadisc® MH washer is used for mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with Sarnafast® fasteners. Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over hard substrates.Suitable roofing system under 70% R.H. environment without chemical corrosion condition.
advantages: Resistant to most common environmental influences
Ease of application in use with recommended setting tools

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Product does not expire during correct storage.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened an undamaged packaging in dry conditions between + 5 °C and + 30 °C. Always refer to pack- aging. Do not stack pallets or any other material on top during transportion or storage.

items.label: System structure
items.text: The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design: Sarnafast® Fastener 4.8 / 5.5 / 6.0 / 6.3

items.label: Corrosion resistance
items.text:
Property | Value | Standard
Salt spray test | ≥ 1200 hours | GB/T 10125-2012
Kesternich test | ≥ 15 cycles | GB/T 9789-2008

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Sarnadisc® MH washer must be installed in accordance with Sika application manual and installation instructions. Sarnadisc® MH washer in combination with appropriate Sarnafast® Fastener is used for the mechanical fastening of roofing waterproofing membrane. For more information look up the Product Data Sheet Sarnafast® fastener.
